featured_reviews.name: Joy caste
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had been struggling with my 4-year-old son’s severe allergy issues since he was just 6–8 months old. Even the slightest exposure to dust from curtains, pillows, mattresses, mud, or anything similar would trigger nonstop sneezing, watery eyes, blocked nose, and constant discomfort. Nights were especially difficult because his nose would remain blocked almost every single night while sleeping.

For the past four years, we visited some of the best pediatricians and ENT specialists. He was continuously on medications like NucKast, Atarax, Dilo ds, Dilo ls, Nebulization and decongestion nasal drops and other allergy medicines.

We were finally advised to go for a 60-allergen test and eventually start allergy vaccinations along with strict avoidance measures. As parents, it had become extremely exhausting and frustrating.

That’s when we decided to consult Dr. Prem Gonsalves for homeopathic treatment. Honestly, it was one of the best decisions we made for our child.

The way Dr. Prem Gonsalves explained everything to us gave us so much confidence and hope. Most importantly, within just one month, the improvement in my child’s health was truly unbelievable. He started sleeping peacefully through the night without sneezing, watery eyes, blocked nose, or irritation. Even while travelling in the car — something that would earlier trigger severe sneezing — he now remains absolutely comfortable.

What I appreciate most is that Dr. Prem Gonsalves focuses on complete wellness and overall healing instead of just temporary symptom relief. Slowly and steadily, my child’s health has improved tremendously, and we finally feel at peace after years of struggle.

I am genuinely grateful and would highly recommend Dr. Prem Gonsalves to any parent dealing with chronic allergy issues in their child.
